detail.longDescription: New post: adding Cloudflare Turnstile to an Astro form and verifying tokens in a Cloudflare Worker. The challenge widget on the page is only decoration unless the server refuses bad submissions. The Worker enforces it. Covers keys, CI setup, safe deploy order, origin allowlisting, rate limiting, and DevTools noise. Privacy-preserving, no CAPTCHA puzzles: https://www. rhelmer.org/blog/astro-turnsti le-cloudflare-workers/ # cloudflare # astro # privacy # security # webdev # workers
